component.name: k7ctl
component.summary: FiiO K7 DAC status, native sample rates and headphone EQ for Linux/PipeWire

description.p: FiiO only makes software for the K7 DAC and headphone amplifier for Windows. k7ctl gives Linux the parts that matter.

ul.li: See what the K7 is receiving right now: sample rate, bit depth, PCM or DSD
Let PipeWire play music at its own sample rate instead of resampling everything to 48 kHz
Check that PipeWire's volume isn't throwing away resolution
See which application is keeping the K7 at another sample rate, and which streams are resampled
Headphone EQ with profiles for thousands of headphones from AutoEQ
Keep the K7 awake so the start of sounds isn't cut off, and buffer presets against crackles
Show the installed firmware version and how to update it

description.p: It comes with a system tray icon and a command line tool (k7ctl) with JSON output for scripts and status bars. No root access is needed.
Resampling diagnosis, headphone EQ, keep-awake, latency presets, status bar output, shell completions and a man page.
First release: status, bit-perfect PipeWire setup and a tray icon.
